name: CHEMICAL & MINING CO OF CHILE INC

ads_ratio.source: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-22), cover page: 'Series B common shares, in the form of American Depositary Shares each representing one Series B share' registered on the NYSE; Glossary likewise defines ADR/ADS as 'each representing one series B common share'.
ads_ratio.reason: 20-F filer: per-share figures are per ordinary share and the NYSE price is per ADS; with a 1:1 ratio the two are identical, but make_score requires the ratio declared and sourced from the filer's own 20-F.

overrides_applied.source: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-22), Note 17.6 Executive compensation plan: the share-based compensation plan 'was paid in cash in 2023' and its only stated income-statement expense is ThUS$2,251 for the year ended 2022; Item 16G NYSE-standards comparison states 'SQM does not have equity compensation plans' and that executives participate only in a long-term cash bonus compensation plan; Note 3.29 states compensation plans are share-based payments settled in cash, recognized at fair value through payroll. The other executive plan (Note 17.6 I) is explicitly paid in cash.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for fiscal years 2022, 2023, 2024 of the last 3 under every tag the engine reads (ifrs-full AdjustmentsForSharebasedPayments has no facts in this filer's companyfacts for any year). SQM has no equity-settled share-based payment expense to subtract: it has no equity compensation plans, its one share-based plan was cash-settled (paid in cash in 2023, so its cost is already inside operating cash flow — subtracting it again as SBC would double-count it), and no expense for that plan is stated for 2023 or 2024 (the only stated expense is ThUS$2,251k for 2022, ~0.05% of that year's OCF and cash-settled in any case). The filing-sourced figure for equity SBC in the gap years is $0.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 21 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-22), cover page: 'Series B common shares, in the form of American Depositary Shares each representing one Series B share' registered on the NYSE; Glossary likewise defines ADR/ADS as 'each representing one series B common share'.) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:sbc — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-22), Note 17.6 Executive compensation plan: the share-based compensation plan 'was paid in cash in 2023' and its only stated income-statement expense is ThUS$2,251 for the year ended 2022; Item 16G NYSE-standards comparison states 'SQM does not have equity compensation plans' and that executives participate only in a long-term cash bonus compensation plan; Note 3.29 states compensation plans are share-based payments settled in cash, recognized at fair value through payroll. The other executive plan (Note 17.6 I) is explicitly paid in cash.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 1.7% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.3x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
